observations: The page number «89» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. At the foot, the signature line of the printed sheet: «D. K. D. Vidensk. Selsk. Skr., 7. Række, hist. og filos. Afd. III. 1.» on the left and the sheet number «12» on the right; recorded here, not transcribed as a line.

L01-L03: the sentence of chapter 33 of the Latin text (p. 26, JP2 0058, L19-L21), in italics, without the note numbers of the edition; «horarum» is the reading of O (note 32 there: «horarum] O, om. C»). L04-L08: the bracketed account of the lunar eclipse in C (p. 27, JP2 0059, L05-L34), whose rule adds «dimidium sextae», a twelfth, to the minutes of the casus and of the mora (L23-L25 there). L05: «Zuzatz»; see the critical note.

L16-L19: the computation, set in three columns under the heads of L16 in the smaller type; «1/12 davon :» before the twelfths, the case fraction written {cf:1|12}; the sums below rules under the figures, with the note number 1 after each. Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|»; the empty cells give the columns room and are not printed. L16-L19. Checked: 31′ 25″ : 12 = 2′ 37″; 31′ 25″ + 2′ 37″ = 34′ 2″; 23′ 8″ : 12 = 1′ 55.7″, written 1′ 55″; 23′ 8″ + 1′ 55″ = 25′ 3″.

L20-L35. Checked: 34′ 2″ : 32′ 9″ = 1.0586 h = 1h 3m 30.9s, «1h 3m 30s»; 25′ 3″ : 32′ 9″ = 0.7792 h = 46m 45.0s; twice these are 2h 7m 1s and 1h 33m 30s, together 3h 40m 31s, «3h 40m 30s»; 2h less half of that, 1h 50m 15s, is 0h 9m 45s, «0h 10m», and 2h plus it 3h 50m 15s. The hourly motion of 32′ 9″ at the corrected anomaly 285° 45′ (74° 15′ from the apogee) agrees with the mean motion 32′ 56″ less 32′ 40″ · 0.0861 · cos 74° 15′ = 46″, 32′ 10″ (see p. 46, JP2 0078). Digits more than 12 mean a total eclipse (L24). Oppolzer's partial and total phases, 2h and 1h 44m, make the 3h 44m of the whole eclipse; Meeus's algorithm gives the full moon at 2.63h Terrestrial Time on 30 June 763 (p. 85, JP2 0117), about 1h 43m at Greenwich, near Oppolzer's middle at 1h 42m.

L28: «146,14h», the comma set close between the year and the hour; «Rabīʿ II» upright, with the macron and the ʿayn raised. L32: «(für Greenwich) :», the colon after a thin space (11 px). L24-L27: the five numbered items run on in the paragraph, each «1)», «2)» … set on the line, not raised, separated by long dashes with a space on either side; «Casus + Emersio» in italics with an upright plus sign. L04: «betitelt :» and «(s. p. 27)», the title in italics.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Batt.», «Oppolzer», «Al-Bīrūnī»; italics: the Latin of L01-L05, «horarum» (L03), «Casus» (L22, L26), «halben Mora», «Totale,», «Mora» (L26), «ganzen», «Erdschattens», «Kanon der Finsternisse».
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (9-13 px measured).
